description: Measures the time to launch a single empty kernel (no work), so the time is pure dispatch / grid-scheduling / completion cost. Sweeping num_blocks shows how overhead grows with grid size; block_size is swept as a non-scaling parameter. Emits one record per timed launch with the GPU event time (time_ms) and the host wall-clock launch+synchronize time (host_time_ms) — no averaging; the summary total is the sum of the per-launch GPU event times.

scaling_param.name: num_blocks
scaling_param.description: Number of thread blocks in the (empty) grid; primary axis for launch/scheduling overhead

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block in the empty grid
